newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toei rises on cartoon hopes, hit movie.
newsitem.headline: Toei rises on cartoon hopes, hit movie.

text.p: Movie producer Toei Co Ltd's shares rose on Monday, supported by hopes that an increase in cable television channels will heighten the need for TV programmes, including cartoons, which Toei excels in, brokers said.
They said Toei's latest hit movie, "Shitsurakuen", was also seen as a factor in boosting the share price.
At 0554 GMT, the share was up 18 yen at 788. Earlier in the session it rose to 794 yen, a new high for the 1997 calendar year.

"Abroad, Japanese cartoons are well-received and foreign investors who are seeking to increase the weight of issues in their Japanese media portfolios are attracted to Toei," a trader at a foreign brokerage said.
